tools.name: make_state_diagram
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a UML state diagram or state machine drawn, for example "draw the states of an order" or "make a PDF of this state machine". Takes the diagram text in a line grammar: state Name / state "Long label" as Name / state Name <<choice>> / state Name { ... } (composite, nest up

tools.name: check_state_diagram
tools.description: Use this when the user wants state machine text checked without a drawing, for example "which states are unreachable?" or "check my state diagram for dead ends". Takes the same diagram text as make_state_diagram. Returns ready true or false; when a line breaks the grammar, the line number, the token
